import sys, subprocess, random, struct
sys.path.insert(0,'project')
from wire import packet
random.seed(7)
lines=[]; expect=[]
for i in range(300):
    rank=random.randrange(4); psn=random.randrange(1<<24)
    if random.random()<0.4:
        lines.append(f"{rank} {psn} ACK"); expect.append(packet(rank,psn,ack=True,outgoing=True).hex())
    else:
        D=random.choice([0,1,2,3,17,255,1024])
        pay=bytes(random.randrange(256) for _ in range(4*D))
        lines.append(f"{rank} {psn} {pay.hex() if pay else ''}"); expect.append(packet(rank,psn,pay,outgoing=True).hex())
p=subprocess.run(['/workspace/tmp/t/codec_test'],input="\n".join(lines).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
got=p.stdout.decode().split()
bad=0
for i,(g,e) in enumerate(zip(got,expect)):
    if g!=e:
        bad+=1
        if bad<3: print("MISMATCH",i,"\n got",g,"\n exp",e)
print("compared",len(got),len(expect),"bad",bad)
EOF
